expected_findings.description: Function name is misleading; the test now exercises retry exhaustion with an explicit else/pause rule, but the name suggests testing 'no match' behavior.

The warnings list is now permanently empty with V13 moved to errors, but the infrastructure remains in place across validators.py, loader.py, and errors.py; module docstrings promise a warnings channel that silently produces nothing.
The test verifies the error event but not the gate_evaluated event that was also added to this path; asserting the latter would strengthen coverage of the new behavior.
The validator test only exercises a phase-level AgentGate; the validator also iterates over step.gates including ScriptGate, so a ScriptGate variant would provide complete coverage.
Stale comment references task numbers from the project roadmap (confusing next to the V13 validator) and appears to be planning scaffolding never cleaned up.
